originalUserObligation: All seven sites live with the right resources, linked to each other, easy to find and use for humans and agents.

evidence.baseline: Parent observed science.561.group DNS ENOTFOUND before cutover; a configured wildcard route is not evidence of a received public frontend.

decision.mechanism: Bounded Cloudflare route DATA referencing the unchanged original Worker; new native publication Custom Domain owns the remaining Science paths.
newPublicationOwns: native publication content, search and sitemap
decision.legacyRootAndFeedJsonDisposition: The old frontend root and old /feed.json are retained in the original artifact and unchanged Worker/assets, but their unreceived, misbound Science ingress is superseded by the reviewed public Science publication. This is not a full L-Space frontend migration or canonical L-Space release.
decision.sourceRetention: Keep original Worker script/deployment, bindings, secrets, assets, data and authentication logic unchanged. Preserve no additional host or grant.
decision.privacy: Do not expose protected vault contents or grant repository, authoring, identity, payment or MCP authority. Existing /api/* and /vault* authorization remains in the original Worker.

independentSourceFindings.finding: Legacy shell owns root, index.html, styles.css, app.js, favicon.ico, robots.txt and /js/*.mjs; root/styles/robots collide with the new publication and require this explicit disposition.
Original anonymous dispatch includes healthz, OAuth, public surface/index/rooms, old feeds and shell.

Original protected dispatch identifies Google/Discord sessions before private resources; no session returns 401 access-required, or authorization availability 503 when the existing provider is unavailable.

requiredRuntimeReceiving: Parent reads original deployment/version metadata and confirms the retained original script and assets unchanged after route-only mutation.
Independent GET new portal root and native public artifacts; inspect correct identity and crosslinks.
Independent GET legacy /healthz, /api/v1/surface and /api/v1/public/index; record actual outcomes without inventing expected asset contents.
Independent anonymous GET /api/v1/me, /api/v1/vault/manifest and /vault/index.json; verify private refusal remains, with no credentials or auth exchange.
Independent GET missing-code /oauth/callback if needed to demonstrate preserved auth routing without creating an identity.
limitations: Source inspection and route plan acceptance do not constitute live receiving.
Public legacy asset absence may preserve an original not-found response; this does not establish availability of a new L-Space public collection.
No predecessor source or provider mutation was performed by this reviewer.
